name: @tasopen/mcp-alphabanana
description: MCP server for image generation using Google Gemini AI
long_description: mcp-alphabanana is an MCP server for generating image assets with Google Gemini. It supports fast image generation, transparent PNG/WebP outputs, reference-image guidance, and file or base64 delivery for agent workflows. In Claude Desktop, prefer file output for medium or large images to avoid context-size limits. On Windows, use the FileSystem extension to choose writable output directories and local reference-image paths.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate image assets with Google Gemini, including transparency, reference-image guidance, and multiple output formats. In Claude Desktop, prefer file output and use the FileSystem extension for paths on Windows.

gemini_api_key.description: API key used to call Google Gemini image generation APIs.
